Please solve this issue: You are fixing a Minecraft-parity bug in the Pumpkin server (Rust, target MC 26.2). Work only inside this repo.

Bug B2: forceload marks chunks but never loads them
Files: the forceload command and the chunk system
What is wrong: `forceload add` reports success and `forceload query` confirms the mark, but the chunk is never loaded, so `setblock` there fails with "not loaded".
Verified vanilla behaviour: 
The change to make: Make the forced set actually pin chunks loaded and ticking.
Be careful: Also fixes our own test rig, which currently keeps a protocol client connected purely as a chunk loader.

Make the smallest change that fixes exactly this. Do not touch unrelated code. When done, run `cargo build -p pumpkin` and make sure it compiles, then stop. Do not commit.
